records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | na maḥ sa ma nta bu ddha nāṃ bhrūṃ | namaḥ sarva tathaha tevika raha viyaḥ saṃmasaṃ budevi yaḥ oṃ ruru saphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo caṇi sarva apatha sadhane svāhā | sa rva ta thā ga te bhyo rha bhyaḥ sa mya ksaṃ bu ddhe ru sphu si ddha lo ca ni sa rva rtha sa dha ne sva ha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhana oṃ mamama ma hūṃ bha | to ṣṇī lo bū rdhna ma ni | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca ana avalokite bu padha tevara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakadha ka vidhaka vidhaka darada ra vidara vidara ra darada hadaha da hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā | bū rdha ja cchi nda bhi nda pha ṭ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dnaya dnaya dnada dahada ṣṇica dunadu na hūṃ | dī pya pyo dga to dhu | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jvala jataṣ ṇica jvala jvala gamandha mandha damada ma taru oṃ taru oṃ taru oṃ ta hana hūṃ | yo ba ndha da pa drūṃ haḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ ṭaru oṃ mandha bhavaha | ṭrūṃ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ vikira ṇa dunadu na śa | mo ki dhūḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sarva vihana vitavi sanaka ra ya ṭaruṭa ya svāhā | ghna dhva sa ṭro | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sa vatara apara dhataya oṃ śamaya śamaya sutenāṃ te dhaśara jabhaṣi te mahavi dya sarva apatha sadhane sava ha | śa ma śā tte dā bha rva rtha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ āḥkaka | āḥ maḥ haṃ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara tihata śasana naṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhane kakara dapati hūṃ j vala jvala dhakadha ka duna viduna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ susu dhadha punakhi ṇi punakhi ṇi haṇara ṇi apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūṃ hūṃ laṭala ṭa svāhā | śa rdhne mā yo tsa da bha ñja pruṃ khi ni ku ṇḍa li | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara ti hata śasana naṃ oṃ apa radhata ta | dhṛka | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ lokaca la adhiṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā | a du bu ddha pa ttra | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada pagama java śicasaṃ mantena svāhā | va rṣa tu de sa ma nte | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga naṃ paravi suma asika tabha sarva taṣṭa naganāṃ ladhami svāhā | ca tu rda kṣu smi kuṃ bhe du ru ndha | saṃladha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā naṃ saṃsina viviṭha yaṃti ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | namo sarva kiñava namo gatana ta rayāva namo amita bhavata thahata yā rahate saṃmasaṃ budha va namaḥ ariva avalokite śvava rava bodhisa tavava maha satava va mahaka ruṇika va namo mahasa thamapa | sthā ma ṅghā mū rtta mu ṇḍa ṇa ma duḥ bhū rbhū ṇa ṭṭa du rga rdha sa ma lo ṅkṛ ḍū ma bhi ntrū da nta dhu ghī cu mu mu yu mu ṇca nāṃ sa ṅha ṭi ṇa || ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | namo gatana tarayā va namaḥ a rivaki ñanasa gara vairo cana vikaha rajava ta thahata yāraha tesaṃma saṃbudha va namaḥ sarva tathaha tevika raha viyaḥ saṃmasaṃ budhana yaḥ na kaari yā avalokite īśvara va bodhisa tavava | jñā vyū dya ca ku || ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | namo gatana tarayā ya namaḥ a riyava lokite īśvara ya bo dhisata vaya mahasa tavaya mahaka ruṇika ya daraya na sapaya navina va śirava ṇa samara vana vatama haṃ sarva sa | da rśa va ṇa vyā tsa ṭṭe ṭu ṅka ṭṭa ṭṭa ṅka || ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | na maḥ sa ma nta bu ddha nāṃ bhrūṃ | namaḥ sarva tathaha tevika raha viyaḥ saṃmasaṃ budevi yaḥ oṃ ruru saphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo caṇi sarva apatha sadhane svāhā | sa rva ta thā ga te bhyo rha bhyaḥ sa mya ksaṃ bu ddhe ru sphu si ddha lo ca ni sa rva rtha sa dha ne sva ha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhana oṃ mamama ma hūṃ bha | to ṣṇī lo bū rdhna ma ni | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca ana avalokite bu padha tevara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakadha ka vidhaka vidhaka darada ra vidara vidara ra darada hadaha da hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā | bū rdha ja cchi nda bhi nda pha ṭ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dnaya dnaya dnada dahada ṣṇica dunadu na hūṃ | dī pya pyo dga to dhu | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jvala jataṣ ṇica jvala jvala gamandha mandha damada ma taru oṃ taru oṃ taru oṃ ta hana hūṃ | yo ba ndha da pa drūṃ haḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ ṭaru oṃ mandha bhavaha | ṭrūṃ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ vikira ṇa dunadu na śa | mo ki dhūḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sarva vihana vitavi sanaka ra ya ṭaruṭa ya svāhā | ghna dhva sa ṭro | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sa vatara apara dhataya oṃ śamaya śamaya sutenāṃ te dhaśara jabhaṣi te mahavi dya sarva apatha sadhane sava ha | śa ma śā tte dā bha rva rtha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ āḥkaka | āḥ maḥ haṃ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara tihata śasana naṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhane kakara dapati hūṃ j vala jvala dhakadha ka duna viduna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ susu dhadha punakhi ṇi punakhi ṇi haṇara ṇi apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūṃ hūṃ laṭala ṭa svāhā | śa rdhne mā yo tsa da bha ñja pruṃ khi ni ku ṇḍa li | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara ti hata śasana naṃ oṃ apa radhata ta | dhṛka | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ lokaca la adhiṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā | a du bu ddha pa ttra | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada pagama java śicasaṃ mantena svāhā | va rṣa tu de sa ma nte | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga naṃ paravi suma asika tabha sarva taṣṭa naganāṃ ladhami svāhā | ca tu rda kṣu smi kuṃ bhe du ru ndha | saṃladha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā naṃ saṃsina viviṭha yaṃti ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | na maḥ sa ma nta bu ddha nāṃ bhrūṃ | namaḥ sarva tathaha tevika raha viyaḥ saṃmasaṃ budevi yaḥ oṃ ruru saphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo caṇi sarva apatha sadhane svāhā | sa rva ta thā ga te bhyo rha bhyaḥ sa mya ksaṃ bu ddhe ru sphu si ddha lo ca ni sa rva rtha sa dha ne sva ha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhana oṃ mamama ma hūṃ bha | to ṣṇī lo bū rdhna ma ni | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca ana avalokite bu padha tevara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakadha ka vidhaka vidhaka darada ra vidara vidara ra darada hadaha da hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā | bū rdha ja cchi nda bhi nda pha ṭ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dnaya dnaya dnada dahada ṣṇica dunadu na hūṃ | dī pya pyo dga to dhu | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jvala jataṣ ṇica jvala jvala gamandha mandha damada ma taru oṃ taru oṃ taru oṃ ta hana hūṃ | yo ba ndha da pa drūṃ haḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ ṭaru oṃ mandha bhavaha | ṭrūṃ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ vikira ṇa dunadu na śa | mo ki dhūḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sarva vihana vitavi sanaka ra ya ṭaruṭa ya svāhā | ghna dhva sa ṭro | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sa vatara apara dhataya oṃ śamaya śamaya sutenāṃ te dhaśara jabhaṣi te mahavi dya sarva apatha sadhane sava ha | śa ma śā tte dā bha rva rtha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ āḥkaka | āḥ maḥ haṃ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara tihata śasana naṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhane kakara dapati hūṃ j vala jvala dhakadha ka duna viduna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ susu dhadha punakhi ṇi punakhi ṇi haṇara ṇi apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūṃ hūṃ laṭala ṭa svāhā | śa rdhne mā yo tsa da bha ñja pruṃ khi ni ku ṇḍa li | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara ti hata śasana naṃ oṃ apa radhata ta | dhṛka | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ lokaca la adhiṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā | a du bu ddha pa ttra | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada pagama java śicasaṃ mantena svāhā | va rṣa tu de sa ma nte | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga naṃ paravi suma asika tabha sarva taṣṭa naganāṃ ladhami svāhā | ca tu rda kṣu smi kuṃ bhe du ru ndha | saṃladha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā naṃ saṃsina viviṭha yaṃti ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | na maḥ sa ma nta bu ddha nāṃ bhrūṃ | namaḥ sarva tathaha tevika raha viyaḥ saṃmasaṃ budevi yaḥ oṃ ruru saphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo caṇi sarva apatha sadhane svāhā | sa rva ta thā ga te bhyo rha bhyaḥ sa mya ksaṃ bu ddhe ru sphu si ddha lo ca ni sa rva rtha sa dha ne sva ha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhana oṃ mamama ma hūṃ bha | to ṣṇī lo bū rdhna ma ni | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca ana avalokite bu padha tevara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakadha ka vidhaka vidhaka darada ra vidara vidara ra darada hadaha da hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā | bū rdha ja cchi nda bhi nda pha ṭ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dnaya dnaya dnada dahada ṣṇica dunadu na hūṃ | dī pya pyo dga to dhu | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jvala jataṣ ṇica jvala jvala gamandha mandha damada ma taru oṃ taru oṃ taru oṃ ta hana hūṃ | yo ba ndha da pa drūṃ haḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ ṭaru oṃ mandha bhavaha | ṭrūṃ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ vikira ṇa dunadu na śa | mo ki dhūḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sarva vihana vitavi sanaka ra ya ṭaruṭa ya svāhā | ghna dhva sa ṭro | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sa vatara apara dhataya oṃ śamaya śamaya sutenāṃ te dhaśara jabhaṣi te mahavi dya sarva apatha sadhane sava ha | śa ma śā tte dā bha rva rtha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ āḥkaka | āḥ maḥ haṃ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara tihata śasana naṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhane kakara dapati hūṃ j vala jvala dhakadha ka duna viduna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ susu dhadha punakhi ṇi punakhi ṇi haṇara ṇi apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūṃ hūṃ laṭala ṭa svāhā | śa rdhne mā yo tsa da bha ñja pruṃ khi ni ku ṇḍa li | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara ti hata śasana naṃ oṃ apa radhata ta | dhṛka | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ lokaca la adhiṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā | a du bu ddha pa ttra | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada pagama java śicasaṃ mantena svāhā | va rṣa tu de sa ma nte | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga naṃ paravi suma asika tabha sarva taṣṭa naganāṃ ladhami svāhā | ca tu rda kṣu smi kuṃ bhe du ru ndha | saṃladha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā naṃ saṃsina viviṭha yaṃti ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | na maḥ sa ma nta bu ddha nāṃ bhrūṃ | namaḥ sarva tathaha tevika raha viyaḥ saṃmasaṃ budevi yaḥ oṃ ruru saphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo caṇi sarva apatha sadhane svāhā | sa rva ta thā ga te bhyo rha bhyaḥ sa mya ksaṃ bu ddhe ru sphu si ddha lo ca ni sa rva rtha sa dha ne sva ha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhana oṃ mamama ma hūṃ bha | to ṣṇī lo bū rdhna ma ni | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca ana avalokite bu padha tevara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakadha ka vidhaka vidhaka darada ra vidara vidara ra darada hadaha da hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā | bū rdha ja cchi nda bhi nda pha ṭ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dnaya dnaya dnada dahada ṣṇica dunadu na hūṃ | dī pya pyo dga to dhu | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jvala jataṣ ṇica jvala jvala gamandha mandha damada ma taru oṃ taru oṃ taru oṃ ta hana hūṃ | yo ba ndha da pa drūṃ haḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ ṭaru oṃ mandha bhavaha | ṭrūṃ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ vikira ṇa dunadu na śa | mo ki dhūḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sarva vihana vitavi sanaka ra ya ṭaruṭa ya svāhā | ghna dhva sa ṭro | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sa vatara apara dhataya oṃ śamaya śamaya sutenāṃ te dhaśara jabhaṣi te mahavi dya sarva apatha sadhane sava ha | śa ma śā tte dā bha rva rtha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ āḥkaka | āḥ maḥ haṃ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara tihata śasana naṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhane kakara dapati hūṃ j vala jvala dhakadha ka duna viduna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ susu dhadha punakhi ṇi punakhi ṇi haṇara ṇi apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūṃ hūṃ laṭala ṭa svāhā | śa rdhne mā yo tsa da bha ñja pruṃ khi ni ku ṇḍa li | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara ti hata śasana naṃ oṃ apa radhata ta | dhṛka | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ lokaca la adhiṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā | a du bu ddha pa ttra | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada pagama java śicasaṃ mantena svāhā | va rṣa tu de sa ma nte | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga naṃ paravi suma asika tabha sarva taṣṭa naganāṃ ladhami svāhā | ca tu rda kṣu smi kuṃ bhe du ru ndha | saṃladha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā naṃ saṃsina viviṭha yaṃti ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | na maḥ sa ma nta bu ddha nāṃ bhrūṃ | namaḥ sarva tathaha tevika raha viyaḥ saṃmasaṃ budevi yaḥ oṃ ruru saphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo caṇi sarva apatha sadhane svāhā | sa rva ta thā ga te bhyo rha bhyaḥ sa mya ksaṃ bu ddhe ru sphu si ddha lo ca ni sa rva rtha sa dha ne sva ha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhana oṃ mamama ma hūṃ bha | to ṣṇī lo bū rdhna ma ni | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca ana avalokite bu padha tevara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakadha ka vidhaka vidhaka darada ra vidara vidara ra darada hadaha da hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā | bū rdha ja cchi nda bhi nda pha ṭ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dnaya dnaya dnada dahada ṣṇica dunadu na hūṃ | dī pya pyo dga to dhu | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jvala jataṣ ṇica jvala jvala gamandha mandha damada ma taru oṃ taru oṃ taru oṃ ta hana hūṃ | yo ba ndha da pa drūṃ haḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ ṭaru oṃ mandha bhavaha | ṭrūṃ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ vikira ṇa dunadu na śa | mo ki dhūḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sarva vihana vitavi sanaka ra ya ṭaruṭa ya svāhā | ghna dhva sa ṭro | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sa vatara apara dhataya oṃ śamaya śamaya sutenāṃ te dhaśara jabhaṣi te mahavi dya sarva apatha sadhane sava ha | śa ma śā tte dā bha rva rtha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ āḥkaka | āḥ maḥ haṃ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara tihata śasana naṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhane kakara dapati hūṃ j vala jvala dhakadha ka duna viduna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ susu dhadha punakhi ṇi punakhi ṇi haṇara ṇi apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūṃ hūṃ laṭala ṭa svāhā | śa rdhne mā yo tsa da bha ñja pruṃ khi ni ku ṇḍa li | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara ti hata śasana naṃ oṃ apa radhata ta | dhṛka | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ lokaca la adhiṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā | a du bu ddha pa ttra | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada pagama java śicasaṃ mantena svāhā | va rṣa tu de sa ma nte | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga naṃ paravi suma asika tabha sarva taṣṭa naganāṃ ladhami svāhā | ca tu rda kṣu smi kuṃ bhe du ru ndha | saṃladha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā naṃ saṃsina viviṭha yaṃti ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | namo gatana tarayā ya namaḥ bha gavate amita bhayata thahata ya namo ariya avalokite śvava raya bodhisa tavaya maha satava ya mahaka ruṇika ya namo mahasa thamapa rapa taya bodhisa tavaya | ā stha ṇa nye jṇī dyaṃ yo sa mṛ mo nna yu ṇḍa ṇḍa bhi ri mbhi ddho grāṃ thi śu ma ṭvā puḥ ja ṅgu || ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | namo gatana tarayā ya namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya bo dhisata vaya mahasa tavaya mahaka ruṇika ya tadyathā śvavaite śvavaisa la śvavaita bhūja śvavaita dasita sa śva vaitama raha rajadha pate jahavi jaha adhate | tā ṅge stre la ṅkṛ da rśa || ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | na maḥ sa ma nta bu ddha nāṃ bhrūṃ | namaḥ sarva tathaha tevika raha viyaḥ saṃmasaṃ budevi yaḥ oṃ ruru saphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo caṇi sarva apatha sadhane svāhā | sa rva ta thā ga te bhyo rha bhyaḥ sa mya ksaṃ bu ddhe ru sphu si ddha lo ca ni sa rva rtha sa dha ne sva ha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhana oṃ mamama ma hūṃ bha | to ṣṇī lo bū rdhna ma ni | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca ana avalokite bu padha tevara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakadha ka vidhaka vidhaka darada ra vidara vidara ra darada hadaha da hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā | bū rdha ja cchi nda bhi nda pha ṭ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dnaya dnaya dnada dahada ṣṇica dunadu na hūṃ | dī pya pyo dga to dhu | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jvala jataṣ ṇica jvala jvala gamandha mandha damada ma taru oṃ taru oṃ taru oṃ ta hana hūṃ | yo ba ndha da pa drūṃ haḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ ṭaru oṃ mandha bhavaha | ṭrūṃ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ vikira ṇa dunadu na śa | mo ki dhūḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sarva vihana vitavi sanaka ra ya ṭaruṭa ya svāhā | ghna dhva sa ṭro | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sa vatara apara dhataya oṃ śamaya śamaya sutenāṃ te dhaśara jabhaṣi te mahavi dya sarva apatha sadhane sava ha | śa ma śā tte dā bha rva rtha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ āḥkaka | āḥ maḥ haṃ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara tihata śasana naṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhane kakara dapati hūṃ j vala jvala dhakadha ka duna viduna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ susu dhadha punakhi ṇi punakhi ṇi haṇara ṇi apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūṃ hūṃ laṭala ṭa svāhā | śa rdhne mā yo tsa da bha ñja pruṃ khi ni ku ṇḍa li | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara ti hata śasana naṃ oṃ apa radhata ta | dhṛka | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ lokaca la adhiṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā | a du bu ddha pa ttra | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada pagama java śicasaṃ mantena svāhā | va rṣa tu de sa ma nte | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga naṃ paravi suma asika tabha sarva taṣṭa naganāṃ ladhami svāhā | ca tu rda kṣu smi kuṃ bhe du ru ndha | saṃladha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā naṃ saṃsina viviṭha yaṃti ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | na maḥ sa ma nta bu ddha nāṃ bhrūṃ | namaḥ sarva tathaha tevika raha viyaḥ saṃmasaṃ budevi yaḥ oṃ ruru saphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo caṇi sarva apatha sadhane svāhā | sa rva ta thā ga te bhyo rha bhyaḥ sa mya ksaṃ bu ddhe ru sphu si ddha lo ca ni sa rva rtha sa dha ne sva ha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhana oṃ mamama ma hūṃ bha | to ṣṇī lo bū rdhna ma ni | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca ana avalokite bu padha tevara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakadha ka vidhaka vidhaka darada ra vidara vidara ra darada hadaha da hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā | bū rdha ja cchi nda bhi nda pha ṭ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dnaya dnaya dnada dahada ṣṇica dunadu na hūṃ | dī pya pyo dga to dhu | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jvala jataṣ ṇica jvala jvala gamandha mandha damada ma taru oṃ taru oṃ taru oṃ ta hana hūṃ | yo ba ndha da pa drūṃ haḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ ṭaru oṃ mandha bhavaha | ṭrūṃ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ vikira ṇa dunadu na śa | mo ki dhūḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sarva vihana vitavi sanaka ra ya ṭaruṭa ya svāhā | ghna dhva sa ṭro | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sa vatara apara dhataya oṃ śamaya śamaya sutenāṃ te dhaśara jabhaṣi te mahavi dya sarva apatha sadhane sava ha | śa ma śā tte dā bha rva rtha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ āḥkaka | āḥ maḥ haṃ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara tihata śasana naṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhane kakara dapati hūṃ j vala jvala dhakadha ka duna viduna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ susu dhadha punakhi ṇi punakhi ṇi haṇara ṇi apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūṃ hūṃ laṭala ṭa svāhā | śa rdhne mā yo tsa da bha ñja pruṃ khi ni ku ṇḍa li | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara ti hata śasana naṃ oṃ apa radhata ta | dhṛka | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ lokaca la adhiṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā | a du bu ddha pa ttra | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada pagama java śicasaṃ mantena svāhā | va rṣa tu de sa ma nte | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga naṃ paravi suma asika tabha sarva taṣṭa naganāṃ ladhami svāhā | ca tu rda kṣu smi kuṃ bhe du ru ndha | saṃladha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā naṃ saṃsina viviṭha yaṃti ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | na maḥ sa ma nta bu ddha nāṃ bhrūṃ | namaḥ sarva tathaha tevika raha viyaḥ saṃmasaṃ budevi yaḥ oṃ ruru saphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo caṇi sarva apatha sadhane svāhā | sa rva ta thā ga te bhyo rha bhyaḥ sa mya ksaṃ bu ddhe ru sphu si ddha lo ca ni sa rva rtha sa dha ne sva ha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhana oṃ mamama ma hūṃ bha | to ṣṇī lo bū rdhna ma ni | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca ana avalokite bu padha tevara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakadha ka vidhaka vidhaka darada ra vidara vidara ra darada hadaha da hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā | bū rdha ja cchi nda bhi nda pha ṭ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dnaya dnaya dnada dahada ṣṇica dunadu na hūṃ | dī pya pyo dga to dhu | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ jvala jataṣ ṇica jvala jvala gamandha mandha damada ma taru oṃ taru oṃ taru oṃ ta hana hūṃ | yo ba ndha da pa drūṃ haḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ ṭaru oṃ mandha bhavaha | ṭrūṃ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya oṃ vikira ṇa dunadu na śa | mo ki dhūḥ | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sarva vihana vitavi sanaka ra ya ṭaruṭa ya svāhā | ghna dhva sa ṭro | namo bhagava daṣṇi caya sa vatara apara dhataya oṃ śamaya śamaya sutenāṃ te dhaśara jabhaṣi te mahavi dya sarva apatha sadhane sava ha | śa ma śā tte dā bha rva rtha | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ āḥkaka | āḥ maḥ haṃ | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara tihata śasana naṃ oṃ tathaha daṣṇi ca anava lokita bu padhane kakara dapati hūṃ j vala jvala dhakadha ka duna viduna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ susu dhadha punakhi ṇi punakhi ṇi haṇara ṇi apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūṃ hūṃ laṭala ṭa svāhā | śa rdhne mā yo tsa da bha ñja pruṃ khi ni ku ṇḍa li | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ apara ti hata śasana naṃ oṃ apa radhata ta | dhṛka | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ lokaca la adhiṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā | a du bu ddha pa ttra | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada pagama java śicasaṃ mantena svāhā | va rṣa tu de sa ma nte | namaḥ saṃmanta budhanaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga naṃ paravi suma asika tabha sarva taṣṭa naganāṃ ladhami svāhā | ca tu rda kṣu smi kuṃ bhe du ru ndha | saṃladha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā naṃ saṃsina viviṭha yaṃti ||

records.reconstructedIast: namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ bhrūṃ namaḥ sarva tathaga tebhyo rha bhyaḥ samyasa buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ruru sphuru jvala tiṣṭha sidhalo canī sarva a rdhna thasadha ne svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhana oṃ mamama ma hūm̐ bha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca ana avalokite mu rdha tejara śī oṃ jvala jvala dhakkadha kka vīdhakka vīdhakka darada ra vīdara vīdara ra darada hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jva la jvala dīpyadī pya dīpyo dgatoṣṇī ca dhunadhu na hūm̐ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ jvala jayoṣṇī ca jvala jvala gabadha badha damada ma drūṃdrūṃdrūṃ ta hana hūm̐ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ ṭrūṃbadha bhavaha namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya oṃ vīkira ṇa dhunadhu na dhūḥ namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sarva vīghna vīdhvasa nakkara ya ṭroṭaya svāhā namo bhagava toṣṇīca ya sa vatara apara dhaptaya oṃ śamaya śamaya śāttedā tte dhaśara jabhaṣi tte mahavī dīya sarva a rdhna thasadha ne sava ha namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ āḥmahaṃ namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara tihata śasana daṃ oṃ tathaga toṣṇīca anava lokita mu rdhane kakara da rdhna ti hūm̐ j vala jvala dhakkadha kka dhuna vīdhuna tarasa ya malaka bhadaya hanaha na dajada ja aṃaṃ aḥaḥ dhadha punakhi nī punakhi nī haṇara nī apara dhata satara dhariṇi hūm̐hūm̐ laṭala ṭa svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ apa radhata ta namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ lokkaca la adhīḥṣ ṭhita dhasadha raya maha nubhava budhapa tara svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ sarva nagada rdhna gamaja va śicasa batena svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ oṃ bharu oṃ jatura nanaga daṃ paravī śāma asika tabha sarva duṣṭa nagaṇāṃ rudhami svāhā saṃrudha mi vasuki parasu kha nagara janu hamanu ṣiyā daṃ saṃsina vīviṭha yaṃti namaḥ saba tabudha daṃ bharu oṃ jatu panana gadaṃ paravī ya asika tabha sarva duṣṭa naga daṃ sadhami svāhā namaḥ sabata budhadaṃ apara ti hata śasana daṃ oṃ tatha gatoṣṇī ca anava lokita mu rdha tejara śī hūm̐ jvala j vala nakkana kka vīnakka vīna kka darada ra vīdara vīdara radara da hadaha da hūm̐hūm̐ sarva duṣṭa nagada rdhna castaṃ namaḥ sarva budhabo dhīḥsata vai bhyaḥ namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣa ya namo amita bhayata thamata yāraha te samyaksaṃbuddhāya namo bhagavate vīra vajradhara yasaga ranirgu ṣaiya tathāgatāya namaḥ samantabuddhānām oṃ sitātapatra uṣṇīṣa apara jite pratyangirā ya sarva bhūtama rahani maraha karaṇi paravī nivala dani akkara miriti yapari taraṇa kari sarva badhana mulaṇi sarva duḥṣṭa duḥsava panani varaṇi catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka ri aṣṭa vīśati ṇāṃnakṣa sutara ṇāṃpara sadana kari aṣṭa ṇāṃmahāma rahaṇāṃ vītala sanaka ri sarva caturo nivara ṇi guraduḥ savapa naṇāṃca naśaṇi vīṣaca satara agini utara ṇi aparājita mahāgura mahābhara mahādaṇa mahānipa tamahāte jamahāśva vaitamahā jvala mahāraṇa ravasi ṇi ariya tarabha rikoṭiga vavīja ya vajra mareti vīmaru ta paduma kka vajra jihava camala gava aparājita vajra dāvīśa lacaśā tavaide hakaji ta sumiya rupamahā śvavaita ariya taramahā bhara apara vajra dhalaga va vajra kumari kulaṃdha ri vajra hasata camahāvī nivaja canama kka kusubha ratana gavavai rocana kulatha da uṣṇīṣa vījrīḥbha maṇaca sarva tarakka nakkapa rabhalo cana vajra bhacaśva vaitaca kkamala kṣalaśa śipara bha itete mudara gaṇasa vairakṣa lakuva tomama sarvasattva ṇāṃca oṃ riṣga ṇapara śasata ya sarva tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra hūm̐turu oṃ jaṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ staṃbhana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mohana karihūm̐ turu oṃ mahāvīni vasabha laṇaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ paravī nivasa bhalaṇa karihūm̐ turu oṃ sarva duḥṣṭa ṇāṃstaṃbha nakari hūm̐turu oṃ sarva yaḥlara kṣalasa maraha ṇāṃvīta lasana karihūm̐ turu oṃ catora śītiṇāṃ maraha vītala sanaka rihūm̐tu ru oṃ rakṣala rakṣala maṃ bhagavaṃ tathama tuṣṇīṣa sitātapatra mahāvata roṣṇīṣa mahāpara tirada ramahāsa | namo gatana tarayā ya namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya bo dhisata vaya mahasa tavaya mahaka ruṇika ya tadyathā asa tasa tutasa tusa hipaña habha cakṣama cakṣama māṃ sarva duḥvipa daravai | ra ṇya duḥ kho || ||
